pure_free_sites.name: Brownbook
pure_free_sites.lede: Global business directory with a basic listing form and website field.

must: Search for an existing listing before adding a duplicate.
Provide the business name, category and country.

steps: Search for the business name and town.
Open Add a business and enter the required business details.
Add the business website and complete the remaining submission step.
pure_free_sites.tip: Use consistent business details. The form includes website and social fields; claiming an existing listing gives you control of its information.

pure_free_sites.name: Business Software
pure_free_sites.lede: Business software listing site with an Add Your Product page. Approved products get a public page.

must: Provide your name, email, company name and product name.
Complete the CAPTCHA and agree to the publishing/marketing disclaimer.

steps: Open Add Your Product.
Complete the required product and company fields.
Submit the form and watch for follow-up to complete the listing.
pure_free_sites.tip: The team says it will contact you within two business days to finish the submission. Read the disclaimer covering publication and marketing use.

pure_free_sites.name: StartupTracker
pure_free_sites.price_note: Official crowdsourcing page states that startup listings are 100% free.
pure_free_sites.lede: Crowdsourced startup tracker. Added projects get a public page with a link to the site.
steps: Open the crowdsourcing page to verify an existing profile or begin a new one.
Enter the startup name without Inc/Ltd and the website URL.
Review any further requirements before submitting.
pure_free_sites.tip: The crowdsourcing page now exposes startup-name and website-URL fields. Check for an existing profile before adding one; the later submission steps were not tested.

pure_free_sites.name: nologin.tools
pure_free_sites.price_note: Basic listing is free. Adding the site badge gives priority review and a ranking boost.
pure_free_sites.lede: Directory of tools whose core features work without an account. Basic listings are free and reviewed.

must: The tool's core functionality must work without signing up or logging in.
Provide the tool URL and confirm it meets the rules.
not_needed: Contact email is optional on the submission form.

steps: Open the submission form and add the tool URL.
Confirm the no-login requirement and submit for review.
pure_free_sites.tip: One submitter reported submitting on July 30 and seeing the listing live about 20 days later. They checked the listing URL directly because it was absent from the sitemap. Treat that as one experience, not the current review schedule. The official form now says the badge is optional and grants priority review.

pure_free_sites.name: Fundl
pure_free_sites.price_note: A basic shareable traction page is advertised as free; crowdfunding terms are separate.
pure_free_sites.lede: Project platform with free public traction pages and optional reward-based crowdfunding.

must: Sign in to create a project.
Provide a project name, description, image and link.

steps: Open Create Project and sign in.
Add project details and connect relevant traction sources.
Review the public page before sharing it.
pure_free_sites.tip: The current product focuses on project details and connected traction data. A free page does not prove that every submission is accepted without review.

pure_free_sites.name: Human or Not
pure_free_sites.lede: A directory of AI tools that publishes reviewed listings with a link.

must: The submitted tool must include AI features.
Provide a contact email and tool URL.

pure_free_sites.tip: The form advertises a free lifetime listing within 48 hours. Publication depends on meeting the AI-tool requirement.

pure_free_sites.name: DevPages
pure_free_sites.lede: Tool directory for developers with a Submit a Tool page. Listed tools get a public page linking to the site.

must: Provide the developer tool name, description, website, category, pricing and contact email.

steps: Open Submit a Tool.
Complete required product fields; add GitHub and tags if useful.
Submit the tool for review.
pure_free_sites.tip: Explain the developer task the tool solves. DevPages says every submission is read by hand and uses your email to report the outcome.

freemium_sites.name: WordPress.com
freemium_sites.price_note: Free plan; Personal US$9/month or US$4/month billed annually (US$48/year), excluding taxes
freemium_sites.lede: Hosted blogging platform for publishing articles that can link to your site.

must: A WordPress.com account
Original pages or posts that follow the service terms

steps: Create a WordPress.com site and choose its address.
Write your page or post and add relevant links.
Publish the content.
freemium_sites.tip: The free plan includes a WordPress.com address and displays ads. Use the standard editor for the free route: building with the WordPress Agent requires a paid plan. Link settings can optionally mark individual links nofollow.

freemium_sites.name: Notion
freemium_sites.price_note: Unlimited free notion.site pages; custom-domain add-on $10/month or $8/month billed annually, per domain, plus a paid plan and domain registration (currency code unconfirmed)
freemium_sites.lede: Workspace tool that can publish public pages, usable for articles that link to your site.

must: A Notion account and a page to publish

steps: Open Share on your page, then Publish.
Choose Publish and copy the public site URL.
Check the page and its subpages while signed out.
freemium_sites.tip: Free Sites can enable search engine indexing. Custom-domain connection needs an existing paid plan plus a separate add-on. Publishing also exposes subpages by default and contributor names, photos and email addresses in page metadata; inspect the public result before sharing.

freemium_sites.name: Webflow
freemium_sites.price_note: Free Starter: webflow.io domain, 2 static pages, 1GB bandwidth and limited CMS. Paid plans add custom domains.
freemium_sites.lede: Visual website builder with a free Starter site on a webflow.io address.

must: Create a Webflow account.
Keep a free Starter site within its page and bandwidth limits.

steps: Create a site from a template or blank project.
Add your project content and website links.
Publish to the free webflow.io address.
freemium_sites.tip: The free plan is suitable for a small project site. Check page and CMS limits before building; custom-domain hosting requires a paid Site plan.

freemium_sites.name: Carrd
freemium_sites.price_note: Free: 3 sites. Pro Lite $9/year; Pro Standard with custom domains $19/year.
freemium_sites.lede: One-page website builder with a free plan for up to three sites.

must: Create a Carrd account to manage published sites.

steps: Choose a template or blank page.
Add your content and website links.
Publish on a Carrd address or a supported paid custom domain.
freemium_sites.tip: Use the free Carrd address for a simple page. Custom domains and forms require an appropriate Pro plan.

freemium_sites.name: AlternativeTo
freemium_sites.price_note: Free review queue; paid Priority review
freemium_sites.lede: Software directory where people compare products and suggest alternatives to existing applications.

must: Register and verify your email
Product must be public and in English
No thin AI wrappers, simple tool lists or unreleased/private-beta products
Do not use your profile for advertising

steps: Register and verify your email
Choose Suggest new application from the user menu
Fill in platforms, license, description, tags and official URL, then submit
Optionally buy priority review at the fee shown after submission
Check My submissions for the waiting status
freemium_sites.tip: The normal queue may not be reviewed for a long time, and review is not guaranteed. Paid priority usually takes 1–2 business days, or up to a week during busy periods, but does not guarantee approval. Check eligibility before paying.

freemium_sites.name: SaaSHub
freemium_sites.price_note: Free listing; featured promotion is $99/month, cancel anytime
freemium_sites.lede: Software directory organised around categories and alternatives. Products go through approval before publication.

must: An English-language product that is already released
A product website on an independent domain
Add relevant categories and competing products

steps: Enter your product URL on the submission page
Add categories and the products yours can replace
Verify an email on your product domain to improve review priority
freemium_sites.tip: Missing competitors can send your submission to the back of the queue. Domain-email verification improves its priority; unreleased products, waitlists and development agencies are excluded.

freemium_sites.name: Uneed
freemium_sites.price_note: Free queue; Fast-track $14.99; Skip the line $29.99; relaunch $15
freemium_sites.lede: Product launchpad with a free queue, a paid fast-track queue and a paid option to choose your launch date.

must: Product name and website URL
Create an account to save the imported product details
Free launches need an upvote score of 10 to stay published; 20 for a dofollow link

steps: Enter your product name and URL to preview imported details
Sign up to save the product and review its information
Join the free queue, choose Fast-track or pay to choose a launch date
freemium_sites.tip: The free queue can assign a date up to five months away. Fast-track quotes about 14 days; free and Fast-track links have different vote-score thresholds.

freemium_sites.name: ShowMeBest
freemium_sites.price_note: Free; Basic $9.99; Pro $49.99
freemium_sites.lede: AI tools directory with free, Basic and Pro listing options. Paid plans offer different listing and featured-placement durations.

must: An AI tool and the information requested in the submission form

steps: Choose Free, Basic or Pro
Provide your tool details
Review payment and listing duration before confirming a paid option
freemium_sites.tip: Basic advertises a permanent listing. Pro’s table says six months, while other page copy uses forever; resolve that difference before purchasing Pro.

freemium_sites.name: SmolLaunch
freemium_sites.price_note: Basic Free without badge; Free Verified with badge. Premium $19 or Premium+ $39 per launch.

asks.text: Free paths: 3 eligible votes this week

freemium_sites.lede: Weekly launch board for indie and SaaS products. Paid ads are marked as sponsored.

must: Free paths: vote on 3 eligible launches by other makers in the current voting week
Free launch is for a product's first launch only
Free Verified requires the site badge and has 50 slots per week
Basic Free has a separate cap and queue
Relaunches require a paid tier
not_needed: No badge for Basic Free or paid launch tiers
No preliminary votes for paid launch tiers

steps: Create an account and add your product.
Choose Basic Free, Free Verified or a paid launch.
For either free path, complete 3 qualifying votes; for Free Verified, also verify the site badge.
Complete the chosen tier's scheduling steps.
freemium_sites.tip: Both free paths require 3 qualifying votes on other makers' eligible launches during the current voting week. Basic Free is nofollow; Free Verified requires a site badge for a dofollow listing. Each path has its own cap and queue; Free Verified has 50 weekly slots. Free covers the first launch only; relaunches are paid. Paid launch tiers need neither badge nor preliminary votes. Featured Spot ads have sponsored links.

freemium_sites.name: Launch
freemium_sites.price_note: Free; Pro $39 one-time; Grow $199; Pass $99/year
freemium_sites.lede: Product launch community for AI tools, SaaS and other technology products.

must: Product name, tagline, screenshots, categories and tech stack

steps: Open the launch guide and follow Submit your product.
Enter product details.
Use the free queue or choose a paid launch date.
freemium_sites.tip: Free launches join the standard queue. Pro lets you choose a date; Grow adds manual directory submissions. Check the estimate shown before submitting.

freemium_sites.name: AIToolNet
freemium_sites.price_note: Start free; Pro $9.90 one-time; Business $49.90 one-time
freemium_sites.lede: AI tools directory with a free queue, a $9.90 faster listing and a $49.90 featured option.

must: An AI tool not already listed; newsletters and directories are excluded
Tool name, website, category and email
Pass the site’s approval process

steps: Search for an existing listing
Choose Start, Pro or Business
Complete the tool details and payment if using a paid plan
Await manual review
freemium_sites.tip: The free tier says 30 days, while the FAQ says the queue can take 30–60 days. Pro quotes 24 hours; Business adds seven days of homepage and category placement.

freemium_sites.name: Best AI Tools Directory
freemium_sites.price_note: Free; Standard $19.90 USD; Pro $29.90 USD, each paid plan one-time
freemium_sites.lede: AI tools directory with a free queue and paid Standard or Pro listings. No reciprocal backlink is required for the listed plans.

must: An AI tool and a selected listing plan

steps: Open Pricing and choose Free, Standard or Pro
Use Submit AI to enter the tool details
Complete payment for a paid plan
freemium_sites.tip: The free queue is quoted at one to six months. Standard and Pro quote listing within 24 hours and seven or 30 featured days. The paid plans explicitly advertise do-follow links; free-plan link rel is not confirmed.

freemium_sites.name: TipSeason
freemium_sites.price_note: Free queue of 90+ days; Premium $49; Ultimate $99. Billing frequency is not stated.
freemium_sites.lede: AI tool directory with a submission page. Approved tools get a public tool page with a link to the official site.

must: Provide email, tool name, descriptions, category, pricing model, use case and website.

steps: Complete the free tool form or choose a paid plan.
Describe the tool and its main use case.
Submit for review and wait for the selected queue.
freemium_sites.tip: The free pricing card has a 90+ day queue despite also mentioning 24-48 hours. Treat the faster timing as paid priority and confirm it before buying.

freemium_sites.name: CurateClick
freemium_sites.price_note: Free; Fast Pass $19.9, Featured $29.9

asks.text: Free dofollow: badge and DR above 5

freemium_sites.lede: Directory for AI, SaaS and online tools with a free tier and paid fast-track options.

must: Product details for the submission form

steps: Open Submit Product and enter the details.
Choose free review or a paid placement.
For the optional free dofollow upgrade, add the badge on a site with DR above 5.
freemium_sites.tip: Ordinary free listings are advertised as nofollow, with one to two months for review and no indexing guarantee. An optional badge on a site with DR above 5 earns a dofollow upgrade. A previous CTA sample was followed, but body links were nofollow; that sample does not describe every listing or placement.

freemium_sites.name: PoweredbyAI
freemium_sites.price_note: Free listing; Pro $11.99 and Elite $69.99 per listing, with no expiry
freemium_sites.lede: Directory that promotes AI tools, with a free manual-review listing and paid permanent plans.

must: A free PoweredByAI account and a verifiable AI product URL
Review the imported product details and required fields

steps: Create a free account and enter your tool URL.
Review the imported name, description, category and logo.
Choose a listing plan and submit for publication.
freemium_sites.tip: About offers free review within 24 to 48 hours. Pro and Elite are permanent paid listings. Check the final plan screen because the submit page emphasizes paid choices.

freemium_sites.name: The AI Library
freemium_sites.price_note: Free submission queue; Premium £298 once; Platinum £499 once.

asks.text: Free submissions wait in a queue

freemium_sites.lede: AI tool library where adding a tool requires signing in. Approved tools get a public tool page.

must: Sign in to submit an AI tool.
Choose the free queue or review a paid launch package.

steps: Open Submit your Tool and sign in.
Add the tool details.
Choose the free queue or the paid package that matches your launch.
freemium_sites.tip: Free listings wait their turn. Current paid launch packages are £298 and £499 once; the older £49 price is not shown on the current page.

freemium_sites.name: Infrabase.ai
freemium_sites.price_note: Free listing; optional Featured placement $49/month.
freemium_sites.lede: AI infrastructure tool directory with a submission entry. Approved tools get a public page with a link.

must: Provide an AI infrastructure product name, URL and contact email.

steps: Open Submit a product.
Enter the product name, website and contact email.
Add a short description if useful and submit.
freemium_sites.tip: The return-link checkbox is optional. The extended listing checkbox is an expression of interest, not a purchase; Featured placement costs $49/month.

freemium_sites.name: Super Launch
freemium_sites.price_note: Core submission and eligibility checks are free; optional sponsored promotion is separate.
freemium_sites.lede: Independent directory for DPIIT-recognised startups registered in India. Free submissions use automated evidence checks, with exceptions sent for human review.

must: Eligible India-registered entity with a matching DPIIT recognition certificate.
Provide legal identifiers, registration details, a live HTTPS website, startup details and submitter email.
Upload the recognition PDF (maximum 5 MB).
Submitter must be at least 18, authorised to represent the entity and permitted to share the submitted content.

steps: Complete the startup, legal-entity and certificate fields.
Confirm authority, content permissions and the certificate-processing notice.
Complete email verification and submit for checks; matches may publish automatically, while exceptions receive human review.
freemium_sites.tip: The platform says matching certificate, legal identifiers, live HTTPS website and own-domain email verification can publish a listing automatically. Personal email addresses or scanned certificates receive manual review. Sponsorship does not buy approval or verification.

freemium_sites.name: DropYourAI
freemium_sites.price_note: Free submission; optional promotion costs $19 for one month or $39 for one year. Renewal type not stated.
freemium_sites.lede: AI tool directory with a Submit Tool page. Approved tools get a public page linking to the site.

must: Provide product name, image, email, website, pricing and descriptions.
Choose an AI category and subcategory.

steps: Complete the tool form.
Choose Submit For Free or review optional promotion.
Send it for editorial review.
freemium_sites.tip: Use Submit For Free for the regular review route. Optional homepage or Top Products promotion has a separate listing term and charge.

freemium_sites.name: ToolFound
freemium_sites.price_note: Free permanent listing. Optional Priority Launch is $29 once; Plus is $99/year, billed annually. Currency displayed as $. Earlier dates and sponsor slots are subject to availability.
freemium_sites.lede: Software launch board with free permanent listings, ownership checks and a visible launch queue.

must: Provide the product URL and an email address.
Verify product ownership before publication.
Use a product-domain email, or a verified personal email plus a meta tag or DNS TXT record.
Optional logo: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP up to 2MB; SVG is not supported.
not_needed: Logo upload (the site icon can be used)

steps: Submit the product URL and email; add a logo or use the site icon.
Review the drafted copy and requested launch date.
Verify ownership to confirm the reservation.
freemium_sites.tip: Badges are optional. Verify a product-domain email, or verify a personal email and prove website control with a meta tag or DNS TXT record. The launch date shown before verification is only an estimate.

must: Provide email, tool name, descriptions, category, pricing model, use case and website.

steps: Complete the free tool form or choose a paid plan.
Describe the tool and its main use case.
Submit for review and wait for the selected queue.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: The free pricing card has a 90+ day queue despite also mentioning 24-48 hours. Treat the faster timing as paid priority and confirm it before buying.

must: Provide the developer tool name, description, website, category, pricing and contact email.

steps: Open Submit a Tool.
Complete required product fields; add GitHub and tags if useful.
Submit the tool for review.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: Explain the developer task the tool solves. DevPages says every submission is read by hand and uses your email to report the outcome.

Add the tool details.

Choose an AI category and subcategory.

Choose Submit For Free or review optional promotion.
Send it for editorial review.

Enter the product name, website and contact email.
Add a short description if useful and submit.

Keep a free Starter site within its page and bandwidth limits.

steps: Create a site from a template or blank project.
Add your project content and website links.
Publish to the free webflow.io address.

Add your content and website links.

all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.name: nologin.tools
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.price_note: Basic listing is free. Adding the site badge gives priority review and a ranking boost.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.lede: Directory of tools whose core features work without an account. Basic listings are free and reviewed.

must: The tool's core functionality must work without signing up or logging in.
Provide the tool URL and confirm it meets the rules.
not_needed: Contact email is optional on the submission form.

steps: Open the submission form and add the tool URL.
Confirm the no-login requirement and submit for review.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: One submitter reported submitting on July 30 and seeing the listing live about 20 days later. They checked the listing URL directly because it was absent from the sitemap. Treat that as one experience, not the current review schedule. The official form now says the badge is optional and grants priority review.

all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.name: Super Launch
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.price_note: Core submission and eligibility checks are free; optional sponsored promotion is separate.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.lede: Independent directory for DPIIT-recognised startups registered in India. Free submissions use automated evidence checks, with exceptions sent for human review.

must: Eligible India-registered entity with a matching DPIIT recognition certificate.
Provide legal identifiers, registration details, a live HTTPS website, startup details and submitter email.
Upload the recognition PDF (maximum 5 MB).
Submitter must be at least 18, authorised to represent the entity and permitted to share the submitted content.

steps: Complete the startup, legal-entity and certificate fields.
Confirm authority, content permissions and the certificate-processing notice.
Complete email verification and submit for checks; matches may publish automatically, while exceptions receive human review.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: The platform says matching certificate, legal identifiers, live HTTPS website and own-domain email verification can publish a listing automatically. Personal email addresses or scanned certificates receive manual review. Sponsorship does not buy approval or verification.

must: Sign in to create a project.
Provide a project name, description, image and link.

steps: Open Create Project and sign in.
Add project details and connect relevant traction sources.
Review the public page before sharing it.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: The current product focuses on project details and connected traction data. A free page does not prove that every submission is accepted without review.

all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.name: SmolLaunch
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.price_note: Basic Free without badge; Free Verified with badge. Premium $19 or Premium+ $39 per launch.

asks.text: Free paths: 3 eligible votes this week

all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.lede: Weekly launch board for indie and SaaS products. Paid ads are marked as sponsored.

must: Free paths: vote on 3 eligible launches by other makers in the current voting week
Free launch is for a product's first launch only
Free Verified requires the site badge and has 50 slots per week
Basic Free has a separate cap and queue
Relaunches require a paid tier
not_needed: No badge for Basic Free or paid launch tiers
No preliminary votes for paid launch tiers

steps: Create an account and add your product.
Choose Basic Free, Free Verified or a paid launch.
For either free path, complete 3 qualifying votes; for Free Verified, also verify the site badge.
Complete the chosen tier's scheduling steps.
all_whitelist_sites_by_rank.tip: Both free paths require 3 qualifying votes on other makers' eligible launches during the current voting week. Basic Free is nofollow; Free Verified requires a site badge for a dofollow listing. Each path has its own cap and queue; Free Verified has 50 weekly slots. Free covers the first launch only; relaunches are paid. Paid launch tiers need neither badge nor preliminary votes. Featured Spot ads have sponsored links.

must: Provide the product URL and an email address.
Verify product ownership before publication.

Review the drafted copy and requested launch date.
Verify ownership to confirm the reservation.
